merchant/32877.htm.text: Recipe Merchant Plani: I traveled all over before settling here. There are so many wondrous things in this world! Everyone tells me to stay where it's safe, but that's too boring. You know, I'd like to know how to make anything and everything in this world. That would be something, wouldn't it?
